product.title: DeliverEmpire — Build Your Food Delivery Dynasty
product.summary: Students build a food-delivery business and meet supply, demand and pricing through running it.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students operate a delivery company, setting prices, managing capacity and responding to demand, then see revenue and customer response move against their choices.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Runs end-to-end and is publicly reachable. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. Real tradeoffs underneath — clicking a city zone moved cash from $10.0M to $9.0M while orders and restaurants rose — but they sit behind a long quiz, and two on-screen defects reproduce.
knownBlockers: Raw HTML entities print literally on screen instead of emoji: "🚀" and "🦸" appear as visible text in achievement toasts and on the coach avatar, on desktop and reproduced twice.
The coach praises any score. Answering every pre-quiz question wrong produced "Nice job! You got 0%!".
Roughly twelve screens, including a five-question quiz, stand between the start and the first real decision.

provenance.evidence: 101-M2-ECON/index.html <title>DeliverEmpire - Build Your Food Delivery Dynasty!</title>. Repo also holds a Google Apps Script (Module 2) and a Track 101 xlsx workbook.
openQuestions: Whether the Apps Script version is the same experience in a second medium was not verified.
